name: joshtv-fable
description: SyncCine - synchronized movie watching with chat (host streams a local MP4 to up to 10 viewers)

scripts.fable: dotnet tool restore && dotnet fable packages/sync-engine --outDir apps/web/src/fable-gen --noCache
scripts.dev: npm run fable && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run fable && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
